answer:
Honest: an identity locks 240 for 15 epochs; anyone may dispute it within 3, a jury of 9 decides within 2.

Forgery: a caught fake loses 80% of its stake, 25% to the challenger, barred 12 epochs. A gale of false disputes cannot sink the honest: failed challenges cost the challenger too.

Costs: the inlet stays open for the honest; the zenith of forgery cost climbs: 1,000 clones lock 240,000; 30% detection forfeits 57,600, 14,400 to challengers.
